description: Reads JavaScript and TypeScript sources, without running them, for two patterns: UNKNOWN_AS_EMPTY (a failed or unexpected read becomes an empty collection, so "unknown" looks like "none") and FAILURE_ONLY_LOGGED (a read stores its data when it succeeds, but its failure is only logged). Each suspect names the read to fail and the check that proves or dismisses it. Use changedSince "main" to scan only what a branch changed. Needs TypeScript in the project.

changedSince.description: Git reference, such as main: scan only the files changed since it, uncommitted and untracked ones included.

paths.description: Files and directories to scan, relative to the working directory. Default: all of it.

name: find_suspects
title: Find failure handling that can lose data
